objectives.title: A friend in the grass
objectives.copy: Find a wild creature, weaken it, then throw a capture orb.

objectives.title: Awaken the meadow
objectives.copy: Visit the blue crystal shrine north of camp and challenge its guardian.
objectives.pin: Follow the blue shrine marker north
objectives.pinElsewhere: Return west from the orchard, then follow the blue shrine marker north

objectives.title: The heart of Amber Ridge
objectives.copy: Travel to Amber Ridge and awaken its shrine. A strong team helps.
objectives.pin: Follow the blue shrine marker north
objectives.pinElsewhere: Take the eastern trail to Ridge

objectives.title: A light in the snow
objectives.copy: Travel to Frostveil Grove and awaken its shrine. A strong team helps.
objectives.pin: Follow the blue shrine marker north
objectives.pinElsewhere: Take the eastern trail to Grove

objectives.title: A hush over Reedfen
objectives.copy: Follow the eastern trail from Frostveil Grove and wake the last shrine.
objectives.pin: Follow the blue shrine marker north
objectives.pinElsewhere: Return to Reedfen from Frostveil Grove

objectives.title: Keeper of the isles
objectives.copy: All four shrines are awake. The remaining friends are there if you want to meet them.

lines.text: Befriend every species if you like ({caught} / {total})

stages.label: Ask what lies beyond the meadow
Compare it with the trail sign
